THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
14 · Crevasse and nothic · area 8
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

The worked stone gives way to a raw split in the earth. Two narrow bridges cross the dark gap, and the space below is difficult to make out.

The break in the cavern floor divides your approach into separate stretches of ground. Its edges and any visible crossing deserve a careful look before someone moves ahead. You can stop to judge the drop or keep to the near side while deciding what you want to investigate.

Ask the players

Do you cross, speak, search, or back away? What do you offer the creature?
